findings.title: No ground plane zones detected
findings.description: Board has 2 copper layers but no ground plane zones were found. A solid ground plane is the single most important EMC design feature.
findings.recommendation: Add a ground pour on B.Cu covering as much area as possible.

findings.title: Decoupling cap moderately far from U2
findings.description: Nearest decoupling cap to U2 (MAX6675_SOIC8_3V3) is 7.0mm away. Recommended: <3mm for best high-frequency performance.
findings.recommendation: Move decoupling cap closer to U2 power pins if layout permits.

findings.title: Decoupling cap moderately far from U3

findings.title: No decoupling cap found near U1
findings.description: U1 (ESP32-S3-WROOM-1) has no capacitor within 10mm. Every IC with power pins needs at least one decoupling capacitor.
findings.recommendation: Add 100nF X7R 0402 + 1µF X5R 0603 close to U1 power pins. For high-speed ICs, add 10nF C0G for high-frequency decoupling. Place caps on the same side as U1 with short, wide traces to vias.
findings.summary: No decoupling cap found near U1

findings.title: No decoupling cap found near U4

findings.summary: No decoupling cap found near U4

findings.title: No EMC filtering near J5
findings.description: Connector J5 (USB_C_Receptacle_XKB_U262-16XN-4BVC11) has no ferrite bead, CM choke, or ESD protection within 25mm. Unfiltered I/O cables are the dominant source of radiated emissions — common-mode current as low as 5 µA can exceed FCC Class B.
findings.recommendation: Add ESD protection (e.g., USBLC6-2SC6 or TPD2E2U06) on J5 data lines. Add ferrite bead (600Ω@100MHz) on VBUS. For USB 3.x, add common-mode choke on SuperSpeed pairs.

findings.recommendation: Ensure JGPIO1 has sufficient ground pins. For high-speed interfaces, ground pins should be distributed among signal pins, not grouped at one end.

findings.title: Board cavity resonance frequencies
findings.description: Board (160×100mm, εr=4.4) cavity resonances: (1,0) at 447 MHz; (0,1) at 715 MHz; (1,1) at 843 MHz; (2,0) at 893 MHz; (2,1) at 1144 MHz. PDN impedance spikes at these frequencies. Ensure adequate decoupling at and around these frequencies.
findings.recommendation: Add decoupling capacitors with SRF near these frequencies.

top_issues.recommendation: Move decoupling cap closer to U3 power pins if layout permits.
top_issues.summary: Decoupling cap moderately far from U3

top_issues.recommendation: Add a ground pour on B.Cu covering as much area as possible.

top_issues.summary: No decoupling cap found near U1
top_issues.recommendation: Add 100nF X7R 0402 + 1µF X5R 0603 close to U1 power pins. For high-speed ICs, add 10nF C0G for high-frequency decoupling. Place caps on the same side as U1 with short, wide traces to vias.

top_issues.summary: No decoupling cap found near U4
top_issues.recommendation: Add 100nF X7R 0402 + 1µF X5R 0603 close to U4 power pins. For high-speed ICs, add 10nF C0G for high-frequency decoupling. Place caps on the same side as U4 with short, wide traces to vias.
Add ESD protection (e.g., USBLC6-2SC6 or TPD2E2U06) on J5 data lines. Add ferrite bead (600Ω@100MHz) on VBUS. For USB 3.x, add common-mode choke on SuperSpeed pairs.
Add ESD protection (e.g., USBLC6-2SC6 or TPD2E2U06) on PADESP14 data lines. Add ferrite bead (600Ω@100MHz) on VBUS. For USB 3.x, add common-mode choke on SuperSpeed pairs.
Add ESD protection (e.g., USBLC6-2SC6 or TPD2E2U06) on PADESP13 data lines. Add ferrite bead (600Ω@100MHz) on VBUS. For USB 3.x, add common-mode choke on SuperSpeed pairs.
